Loan.title: Loan
Loan.description: Represents a single auto loan, storing its primary parameters and metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Loan entity.

loanName.description: User-defined name or reference for the loan.

principalAmount.description: The initial principal amount of the loan.

annualInterestRate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage, used for calculations (e.g., 5.5 for 5.5%).

termMonths.description: The total duration of the loan in months.

startDate.description: The start date of the loan.

currency.description: The currency code for the loan (e.g., AED, USD, EUR, GBP, PHP).

dayCountConvention.description: The day-count convention for interest accrual.

isBullet.description: Flag indicating if the loan has a bullet repayment at maturity.

userId.description: Reference to the user who owns this loan. (Relationship: User 1:N Loan)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the loan record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the loan record was last updated.

Drawdown.title: Drawdown
Drawdown.description: Represents a single drawdown of funds against a loan facility.

userId.description: Denormalized from parent loan for security rules.

ManualPayment.title: ManualPayment
ManualPayment.description: Represents a manual payment made against a loan.

userId.description: Denormalized from parent loan for security rules.

AmortizationPeriod.title: AmortizationPeriod
AmortizationPeriod.description: Represents a single period (month) in the loan's amortization schedule, detailing financial movements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AmortizationPeriod entity. Typically derived from the period number.

loanId.description: Reference to the parent Loan entity. (Relationship: Loan 1:N AmortizationPeriod)

periodNumber.description: The sequential number of the amortization period.

date.description: The end date of the amortization period.

openingBalance.description: The outstanding principal balance at the beginning of the period.

interestAccrual.description: The amount of interest accrued during this period based on the opening balance and monthly rate.

principalPortion.description: The portion of the total payment that reduces the principal balance.

totalPayment.description: The total payment made for this period.

closingBalance.description: The outstanding principal balance at the end of the period.

status.description: The status of this period (e.g., projected, paid, recalculated).

userId.description: Denormalized from parent loan for security rules.

InterestRateChange.title: InterestRateChange
InterestRateChange.description: Records details of an interest rate change applied to a loan, crucial for IFRS 9 prospective recalculation and audit trail.

id.description: Unique identifier for the InterestRateChange entity.

loanId.description: Reference to the Loan entity to which this rate change applies. (Relationship: Loan 1:N InterestRateChange)

newAnnualRate.description: The new annual interest rate applied from the effective period.

effectiveFromPeriod.description: The period number from which the new interest rate becomes effective.

reasonForChange.description: Detailed explanation or justification for the interest rate change.

oldAnnualRate.description: The annual interest rate before this change was applied.

changedAt.description: Timestamp when the interest rate change was recorded.

userId.description: Denormalized from parent loan for security rules.

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: Represents a single journal entry or a set of related journal lines for a specific loan period, compatible with ERP systems like Odoo.

id.description: Unique identifier for the JournalEntry entity.

loanId.description: Reference to the parent Loan entity. (Relationship: Loan 1:N JournalEntry)

periodNumber.description: The amortization period to which this journal entry relates. (Implicitly references AmortizationPeriod via periodNumber)

date.description: The date of the journal entry.

reference.description: A descriptive reference for the journal entry (e.g., 'LoanName - Period X Accrual').

lines.description: An array of individual journal entry lines (debits/credits).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the journal entry was generated.

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description: Records an immutable log of significant actions and changes related to a loan for auditing purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AuditEntry entity.

loanId.description: Reference to the parent Loan entity. (Relationship: Loan 1:N AuditEntry)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action occurred.

actionType.description: Categorization of the action (e.g., 'Schedule Generated', 'Interest Rate Change', 'Period Marked Paid', 'Excel Export').

details.description: A descriptive text providing context for the action.

oldValue.description: A JSON string representation of the data state before the action, if applicable. (e.g., old rate, old status)

newValue.description: A JSON string representation of the data state after the action, if applicable. (e.g., new rate, new status)

userId.description: Reference to the user who performed the action. (Relationship: User 1:N AuditEntry)

definition.description: Stores core loan parameters. Includes `userId` for direct ownership-based authorization.
Stores individual drawdown transactions for a loan.
Stores individual manual payment transactions for a loan.
Stores a single period's amortization details. Denormalized `userId` is used for authorization.
Stores historical records of interest rate changes for a loan. Denormalized `userId` is used for authorization.
Stores generated journal entries for specific periods of a loan. Denormalized `userId` is used for authorization.
Stores immutable audit logs for actions related to a loan. Denormalized `userId` is used for authorization.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure for IFRS LoanGuard prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability by adhering to core design principles, especially Authorization Independence and Query Against Paths (QAPs). To achieve this, the owner's `userId` is denormalized into every document that is logically owned by or associated with a specific user's loan. This eliminates the need for expensive and complex `get()` calls within Firestore Security Rules to check parent documents for ownership. Instead, authorization rules can perform atomic checks directly on the `resource.data` of the document being accessed (e.g., `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId`). This strategy ensures that all queries, whether top-level on `/loans` or on any subcollection, are implicitly and securely filtered by the authenticated user's UID.
